record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Time-dependent well-posedness for delayed nonlocal maturation model
record.original_question: For the delayed and spatially nonlocal model ∂_t u = Δu + d∇·(u∇u_τ) + λuF(u, u_σ), where u_σ(x,t) = ∫_Ω K(x,y)u(y,t−σ)dy and the boundary condition is homogeneous Dirichlet, under what conditions does a unique solution exist for the time-dependent problem?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 26. Under what conditions does a unique solution exist solving the time-dependent problem (2.23) subject to homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain with smooth boundary, and let $\tau, \sigma > 0$ be fixed time delays. Let $K : \Omega \times \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ be a given (sufficiently smooth, nonnegative) kernel, $d, \lambda > 0$ constants, and $F : \mathbb{R} \times \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ a given nonlinearity. For a function $u : \Omega \times [-\max(\tau,\sigma), T] \to \mathbb{R}$, define the spatial nonlocal average
$$ u_\sigma(x,t) \;=\; \int_\Omega K(x,y)\, u(y, t-\sigma)\, dy, $$
and the delayed value $u_\tau(x,t) = u(x, t-\tau)$. Consider the delayed, spatially nonlocal advection-reaction-diffusion problem
$$ \partial_t u \;=\; \Delta u \;+\; d\, \nabla \cdot ( u\, \nabla u_\tau ) \;+\; \lambda\, u\, F(u, u_\sigma), \qquad x\in \Omega,\; t>0, $$
with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition $u(x,t) = 0$ for $x \in \partial\Omega$, $t > 0$, and prescribed history $u(x,t) = \varphi(x,t)$ for $x \in \Omega$, $t \in [-\max(\tau,\sigma), 0]$.

Determine conditions on the kernel $K$, the nonlinearity $F$, the initial history $\varphi$, the parameters $d, \lambda, \tau, \sigma$, and the domain $\Omega$ under which the above initial-boundary value problem admits a unique (classical or weak, suitably defined) solution on a time interval $[0, T]$, and identify the largest $T$ (possibly $T = \infty$) for which such a unique solution exists.
artifact.status_search_result: This is stated as an open problem in a survey of open problems for PDE models with nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping in animal movement. No subsequent work proving general well-posedness of this specific delayed nonlocal advection-diffusion model under homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions was found.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 26. Under what conditions does a unique solution exist solving the time-dependent problem subject to homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions?
status_evidence.claim: The well-posedness question for this delayed nonlocal model is posed as an unresolved open problem.
